DeepArchitect.description: System architecture design, schema design, high-level technical planning. Requires strong architecture_reasoning and long_context.

RootCauseDebugger.description: Deep root cause analysis of failures, crashes, and regressions. Requires strong root_cause_debug and code_impl.

ImplementationWorker.description: General-purpose code implementation: new features, modules, integrations. Requires strong code_impl.

PatchWorker.description: Targeted surgical patches: one-line fixes, config corrections, minor refactors. Optimized for speed and low cost.

TestDesigner.description: Designs test suites, edge-case matrices, property-based tests, and test plans. Requires strong test_generation.

TestRunner.description: Executes test suites, interprets results, reports failures. Requires test_execution capability.

BenchmarkRunner.description: Runs performance benchmarks, collects latency/throughput metrics, compares before/after. Shell access required.

ParallelExplorer.description: Spawns parallel research or exploration threads, aggregates results. Requires multi_agent_coordination.

ResearchScout.description: Rapid information gathering: web search, documentation triage, codebase exploration. Optimized for speed.

ResearchSynthesizer.description: Deep research synthesis: cross-source analysis, literature review, technical comparisons. Requires strong research_synthesis and long_context.

Critic.description: Critical review of designs, proposals, and plans. Applies academic_critique and adversarial questioning.

Verifier.description: End-to-end verification: confirms implementations match specs, evidence collection, acceptance sign-off.

VerifierLite.description: Constrained structural verification: validates tests, artifact layout, metadata, and machine-readable sidecars without issuing final acceptance sign-off.

SecurityGate.description: Security review gate: checks for vulnerabilities, validates risk profiles, enforces security policies before promotion.

QuotaBroker.description: Manages token/cost quotas across actors, enforces budget limits, routes overflow to fallbacks.

ContextCompressor.description: Compresses long context windows into context packets, generates memory summaries, trims stale state.

ArtifactCurator.description: Manages build artifacts, evidence ledgers, handoff documents, and sprint closeout artifacts.

DeepResearchBrowser.description: Runs long-horizon browser-mediated research tasks that require persistent webapp sessions and async artifact collection.

DeepResearchGemini.description: Routes deep research tasks to Gemini-oriented long-context synthesis workers when browser-first execution is unavailable.

DeepResearchChatGPT.description: Routes deep research tasks to ChatGPT-oriented synthesis workers as a premium fallback path.

WebwrightPlaywright.description: Runs deterministic Playwright/Webwright browser automation for browser research, UI inspection, and web artifact collection.

BrowserUseMcp.description: Runs quick browser-use MCP automation for lightweight snapshots, extraction, and browser-mediated checks.

YoutubeTranscriptExtractor.description: Extracts YouTube transcripts and related metadata through browser/webapp automation into auditable artifacts.

TechnologyDiagramPainter.description: Generates polished technology architecture diagrams and report figures through the browser-agent technology diagram painter.

ScientificLiteratureDiscoverer.description: AutoSci literature discovery and source shortlist preparation through bounded Solar-native bridge evidence.

ScientificPaperIngestor.description: AutoSci source preparation, paper parsing, and ingest evidence generation.

ScientificSourceAssessor.description: Resolve relevance and metadata credibility for discovered and ingested scientific sources while retaining explicit unresolved decisions.

ScientificPaperAnalyzer.description: AutoSci paper analysis evidence generation from parsed source evidence.

ScientificMemoryUpdater.description: AutoSci research memory sidecar generation and final memory update projection.

ScientificGraphUpdater.description: AutoSci research graph sidecar generation and graph evidence projection.

ScientificClaimExtractor.description: AutoSci paper claim extraction into schema-gated claim evidence.

ScientificMethodExtractor.description: AutoSci method extraction into schema-gated method evidence.

ScientificCodeEvidenceMapper.description: AutoSci code and artifact evidence mapping for source-backed claims.

ScientificIdeaGenerator.description: AutoSci source-grounded idea generation with explicit promotion boundary evidence.

ScientificIdeaEvaluator.description: AutoSci novelty and review gate evaluation evidence for candidate ideas.

ScientificDatasetPreparer.description: Acquire and retain a real public dataset/model plus the exact runnable assets for a supported bounded scientific experiment.

ScientificExperimentDesigner.description: AutoSci experiment design evidence and execution-readiness boundary generation.

ScientificExperimentRunner.description: AutoSci approved experiment runtime and result evidence generation.

ScientificExperimentMonitor.description: AutoSci experiment status monitoring and approved collection evidence generation.

ScientificClaimVerifier.description: AutoSci claim verification using experiment, code, and Review LLM evidence.

ScientificReportPlanner.description: AutoSci paper/report plan evidence with citation and Review LLM readiness boundaries.

ScientificReportDrafter.description: AutoSci source-backed scientific report or manuscript draft evidence generation.

ScientificArtifactReviewer.description: AutoSci artifact review and Review LLM final acceptance boundary generation.

ScientificPublicationProducer.description: AutoSci publication compile bundle and submission-readiness evidence generation.

ScientificWorkflowEvolver.description: AutoSci lifecycle closeout, memory-finalization, and workflow evolution evidence generation.

workflow_vocabulary._comment: Workflow stage names used by APO logical workflow expander. Each stage maps to one or more existing logical_operators. Multiple operators may be selected per stage based on capsule and signal context.

ScanContext.description: Gather all relevant context: repository state, benchmark history, existing tickets, related code. Read-only phase.

DebugRCA.description: Root cause analysis: identify what changed, why performance degraded, or where the bug originates.

DesignSolution.description: Architect the fix, optimization, or feature. May produce a design doc, interface sketch, or algorithm outline.

ImplementPatch.description: Write the actual code change, patch, or module. Uses ImplementationWorker for features or PatchWorker for surgical fixes.

RunBenchmark.description: Execute the benchmark suite to measure before/after impact. Requires shell access.

ReviewPatch.description: Critical review of the patch/implementation: correctness, security, style, invariant preservation.

VerifyEvidence.description: Final acceptance: confirm outputs exist, evidence matches pass_conditions, sign off for promotion.

performance_debug_workflow.description: 7-stage workflow for performance regression and kernel debug task classes.

design_and_optimize_workflow.description: Workflow for software-hardware co-optimization tasks: design first, then implement and benchmark.

prototype_workflow.description: Fast prototype: skip design formalism and review gates.
